{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = '/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv'

treatment_response_rate = treatment_group['responded'].mean()
control_response_rate = control_group['responded'].mean()

# Difference in proportions
treatment_effect = treatment_response_rate - control_response_rate

treatment_response_rate, control_response_rate, treatment_effect"}
